parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human cellular tumor antigen p53 (CHEMBL4096). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Filter for Homo sapiens assay organism. Require canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
